document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
This is a rare opportunity in a lifetime dedicated to anthropology. 
Heart pounding, you stand up before this representative of an 
unknown  race,  your  hands  spread  in  a  peaceful  gesture. The 
little  man  lurches  in  surprise  and  then  darts  off,  trilling  an 
alarmed cry.

To follow the frightened primitive, go to 196. To clear out of the 
area before he returns with friends, go to 131.
